mainObjectsImplemented: Square raised stone diorama and ground receiver
Timber pavilion with curved hip roof, lifted corners, finial, carved rails, plinth, stairs and stone table
Irregular jade pond with planar reflection and procedural ripples
Arched bridge with pierced stone rail panels
True circular moon gate through plaster wall
Tiled wall caps and return wall
Two faceted cloud pines with branching trunks
Jointed bamboo grove with lance leaves
Pierced scholar rocks and faceted bank stones
Shrubs, grasses, small warm maples and stepping stones
Lotus pads and apricot flowers
rendering: Custom warm diffuse and hemisphere WGSL
Screen-space contact occlusion from resolved normal/depth MRT
Completed GPU queue work before readiness
knownGaps: Composition and botanical density remain approximate to reference
No physically based material/IBL system, refraction or volumetric scattering
Scholar stones are more angular and less organically sculpted than reference
Some pine foliage overlaps the pavilion roof as part of the composition

frameworkFriction.issue: vgpu/scene 0.6.0 has transforms, geometry recipes and camera utilities but no built-in material, light, shadow or renderer system
frameworkFriction.workaround: Authored the complete shading, shadow, reflection and post passes in WGSL with vGPU native draw/frame APIs

frameworkFriction.issue: Initial build rejected WGSL reserved identifier patch
frameworkFriction.workaround: Exact diagnostic identified it; renamed to waterTint

frameworkFriction.issue: MSAA depth attachment is discarded after the render pass, so direct depth sampling produced excess occlusion
frameworkFriction.workaround: Stored depth in alpha of a resolved rgba16float normal MRT; retained 4x MSAA

estimatedActiveTasks.reasoning: Substantial composition and procedural geometry work; several visual comparisons
estimatedActiveTasks.build: Short Vite shader builds; six shared capture builds plus local compile checks
estimatedActiveTasks.debug: One compile-time shader identifier fix and one postprocessing depth-lifetime correction
estimatedActiveTasks.queueOverlap: 72.4 s refined-03 queue overlapped visual planning and API reading; 7.1 s composition-04 queue

result.reproductionNote: Run from /workspace/aperture in a fresh trial; existing labels are immutable and this trial used six attempts. README explains fresh-label reproduction.

plaster boundary walls with tiled coping
open circular stone moon gate
curved four-sided pavilion roof and finial

platform, stairs and stone furniture

knownGaps: Composition and proportions are approximate rather than pixel matched.
Pine cloud shapes, roof panels and plant clusters are more geometric than the reference.
Stonework near the pavilion is crowded.
Water reflection uses a planar reflector with subtle procedural distortion, without fluid simulation.
frameworkFriction: WebGPURenderer enables automatic WebGL fallback by default; explicitly disabled renderer._getFallback.
PCFSoftShadowMap WebGPU filtering was removed in r186; used PCFShadowMap.
GTAO with inherited MSAA depth generated invalid textureGather WGSL on capture 3. Explicit non-MSAA scene pass plus FXAA resolved it without framework edits.
authorErrors: Initial procedural triangle winding hid some roof, wall-cap and paving surfaces; corrected material sidedness.
